子.description: An integrated shape with a curved upper stroke, central hook and crossing horizontal; use the full three-stroke sequence.

午.description: An integrated shape with a short upper slant and a central vertical crossing the horizontal strokes.

小.description: A central hooked stroke with a short stroke on each side.

一.description: One horizontal stroke; no separate components are needed.

大.description: An integrated shape with a horizontal stroke crossing two spreading lower strokes.

年.description: A central vertical crosses the horizontal strokes beneath a short upper slant; learn the full stroke sequence as one shape.

书.description: An integrated shape with folded strokes, a crossing vertical and a dot; learn the four strokes as one shape.

人.description: Two connected spreading strokes form one integrated shape.

八.description: Two separate strokes spread left and right; treat them as one character shape.

九.description: A slanting stroke crosses a bent hooked stroke in an integrated shape.

来.description: A central vertical crosses horizontals, with short upper marks and spreading lower strokes; trace the integrated shape.

不.description: A top horizontal sits above a central stroke and two branching strokes; trace the complete four-stroke shape.

有.description: Upper slanting strokes cover the box-like lower shape on the upper-left side; follow the full stroke sequence.

那.description: A compact left-hand shape stands beside the right-hand component 阝; no additional decomposition of the left side is asserted.

今.description: A 人-shaped top sits above a short mark and a bent lower stroke; follow the four strokes as a complete shape.

后.description: Upper and left strokes surround a lower 口-shaped box; no historical origin is inferred.
